claims.description: Finished-loading-empty branch renders subject-picker-empty with localized copy naming the condition and a subject-picker-create escape button routing to Subject creation; confirm stays disabled since no Subject is selectable in this branch.

AC-required regression test (rework) seeds the real production loaded-empty shape — subjects fetch resolves with an empty array (server excludes inactive Subjects by default) — and asserts the empty container renders, loading and resolution-ready testIDs are absent, confirm remains disabled after text entry, and the escape routes to create-subject. The archived-Subject fixture remains only as an explicitly-labelled defense-in-depth case for the client-filter path. Red-green recorded: pre-fix revision fails both new tests on missing subject-picker-empty; restored fix passes all six.
Related suites re-runnable via the standard focused jest invocation.
